text: CloudWay 24 offers an easy and seamless booking experience via their website and mobile app (available for iOS and Android). Follow these steps to book your next international journey!
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24

locations.heading: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24

text:
- Visit CloudWay24.com (https://cloudway24.com) or open the CloudWay 24 app.
- Sign up or log in using your email address or mobile number.
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 1. Sign Up / Log In

text: - Click or tap on "Plan My Flight".
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 2. Start Your Booking

text:
- Choose either:
  - Round Trip
  - One Way
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 3. Select Your Trip Type

text:
- Select your:
  - Source city (e.g., Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru)
  - Destination city (e.g., New York, London, Dubai, Sydney, etc.)
- Enter preferred departure and (if round-trip) return dates.
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 4. Choose Your Route

text:
- CloudLux (First Class)
- CloudElite (Business Class)
- CloudComfort (Premium Economy)
- CloudSaver (Economy)
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 5. Pick Your Cabin Class

text: - Browse available flights and select the one that best suits your schedule and preferences.
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 6. Confirm Flight Options

text: - Fill in details for all travelers in your booking.
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 7. Enter Passenger Details

text:
- Choose your payment method:
  - Credit Card
  - Debit Card
  - Netbanking
  - SkyPoints 24 loyalty points (for eligible members)
- Complete the payment process to confirm your booking.
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 8. Payment

text:
- Receive an instant booking confirmation via email and SMS.
- Your itinerary will also be available in the "Manage My Flight" section.
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Step-by-Step Guide to Booking a Flight > 9. Booking Confirmation

text:
- Cancel your booking
- Change your booking
- Choose or change your seat
- Upgrade your flight
- Manage chauffeur-drive
- Book accessible travel
- Check-in online (or use other check-in options)
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Additional Features > Manage My Flight

text: For additional assistance, visit CloudWay24.com (https://cloudway24.com) or use in-app support.
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Additional Features > Contact & Support

text: Enjoy a seamless booking and flying experience with CloudWay 24 – Seamless Skies, Global Reach.
path: How to Book a Flight with CloudWay 24 > Additional Features
